title: How are flooding and storms affecting wildlife?
description: Recent rain and flooding across Devon and Cornwall is impacting wildlife and their habitats.
content: Hodgson said: "Wildlife have relatively simple needs, they're much like people, they're looking for shelter, food, safety from disease and predators and breeding opportunities."
de: Wie wirken sich Überschwemmungen und Stürme auf die Tierwelt aus? Die jüngsten Regenfälle und Überschwemmungen in Devon und Cornwall haben Auswirkungen auf die Tierwelt und ihre Lebensräume.
en: How are flooding and storms affecting wildlife?. Recent rain and flooding across Devon and Cornwall is impacting wildlife and their habitats.
la: Quomodo inundationes et procellae truculenter afficiunt? Recentes pluviae et inundationes per Devoniam et Cornubiam truculenter et eorum loca impacta sunt.
